scope: Clause locators refer to Adobe PDF32000_2008 (ISO 32000-1) until ISO 32000-2 full text is acquired and reviewed.

requirements.status: implemented for declared unsupported fixture set

requirements.gaps: long fuzz campaigns (a bounded smoke run and replayed findings exist) and process-level sandbox/cancellation

requirements.status: Opt-in scan --repair performs one actual Repair pass; schema2/recovery=repair/strict=null never implies a Strict rendering audit. Default scan schema1 and control flow stay unchanged.
requirements.gaps: An explicit Repair scan is not full Strict validation, independent pixel accuracy, browser evidence or a compatibility admission. Full Strict errors are checked by actual render/API calls separately.
